entities.name: Dakkon Blackblade
entities.description: A warrior and master blacksmith who became a planeswalker after forging a soul-drinking sword for Geyadrone Dihada, who then betrayed him.

entities.name: Geyadrone Dihada
entities.description: A demon planeswalker who bargained with Dakkon to forge her a soul-drinking sword, then absorbed his shadow and soul into it.

entities.name: The soul-drinking sword
entities.description: A sword Dakkon forged for Dihada over ten years, quenched in the blood of his slaves, into which Dakkon's shadow and soul were absorbed.

events.summary: Dihada, sensing the Ember of Dakkon's unignited Spark, offers to make him a planeswalker if he forges her a soul-drinking sword.
events.quote: she offered to make him a Planeswalker if he would forge her a soul-drinking sword.

events.summary: Dakkon works for ten years forging the sword, quenching it in the blood of his slaves.
events.quote: for ten years he worked tirelessly, quenching the sword again and again in the blood of his slaves.

events.summary: Dihada returns to claim the finished sword and keeps her word, igniting Dakkon's Spark.
events.quote: She kept her word, igniting Dakkon’s Spark and unlocking his power as a Planeswalker.

events.summary: Dihada betrays Dakkon by absorbing his shadow and soul into the blade.
events.quote: she quickly betrayed him by absorbing his shadow (and his soul) into the blade.

relations.note: She betrayed him after he forged her sword.
relations.quote: she quickly betrayed him by absorbing his shadow (and his soul) into the blade.
